hero.definition: Full mouth reconstruction rebuilds all of your teeth with crowns, bridges and veneers planned as one case, so the bite works and the smile looks natural. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami it costs $10,000, takes 7 business days across four visits, and includes a 5-year written warranty.
hero.lead: Crowns, bridges and veneers planned together so your bite works and your smile looks natural. Delivered in 7 business days in Miami, with a 5-year warranty in writing.

image.alt: Man laughing freely after full mouth reconstruction
image.caption: Full mouth reconstruction · Every tooth planned together · 7 business days

candidates.title: For teeth that are worn, broken or failing all at once
candidates.intro: Reconstruction treats the whole mouth as one plan, not one tooth at a time.

items.d: Years of grinding have shortened your teeth and aged your face.
Old fillings and crowns breaking one after another.
Jaw pain, headaches, or teeth that no longer meet properly.
Gaps closed with bridges, so you chew on both sides again.
Dark metal margins and mismatched colors replaced in one plan.

why.title: One plan, one lab, two weeks of visits.
why.body: Most clinics rebuild a mouth over months of separate appointments. Our lab is in the building, so every crown, bridge and veneer is designed together, matched together and delivered together.

image.alt: Ceramist hand-finishing a restoration in the in-house lab

facts.label: Timeline
facts.sub: From first exam to final delivery. Two short trips, or stay the two weeks.

facts.label: Materials
facts.sub: Strong where you chew, translucent where it shows.

facts.label: Lifespan
facts.sub: With normal care and a night guard if you grind.

week.title: Your two weeks in Miami
week.intro: Photos, estimate and plan from home. Then four visits across 7 business days.

visits.d: Send photos, get your written estimate within 6 hours, pick a payment plan and reserve with a $250 deposit.
visits.time: Any day, about 2 minutes of your time

visits.d: X-rays, 3D scans and photos. Your doctor plans every tooth with you and confirms the design.
Teeth prepared and fitted with temporaries shaped like your final design. You chew and speak with them for a week.
Fit and bite checked on Monday. Final crowns, bridges and veneers bonded on Wednesday with your warranty in writing.

price.title: One price for the whole mouth, in writing
price.body: Send photos and a doctor writes your estimate within 6 hours. If the exam finds something that must be treated first, you get that in writing too, before anything starts.

faq.title: Reconstruction questions, answered by the doctors

items.a: Preparation is done under local anesthesia. Expect soreness for a few days, managed with over-the-counter pain relief.
Crowns and bridges are often classed as major restorative work and may be covered 50 to 80 percent depending on your plan. We give you the codes for your claim.
Not for this package. Missing teeth are replaced with bridges. If implants would serve you better, your doctor says so in the estimate.
Porcelain and zirconia restorations typically last 10 to 30 years with good care. Ours carry a 5-year written warranty.
Soft foods for the first two days, then everything. Chewing on both sides again is usually the first thing patients notice.

cta.title: Start with photos.
cta.body: Free, no visit needed. Written estimate included.
cta.cardBody: Two photos of your smile, from your phone. Takes 2 minutes.
